prompt: I exported the top 100 most-relevant records per topic. Plot each topic's publications per year to show the trend.
anti_pattern: Using the capped, relevance-sorted corpus's own year distribution as the trend — it is skewed toward recent years. The trend must come from the population Year-facet counts, not the sample.

prompt: It's mid-2026. Rank topics by growth from 2021 to 2026.
anti_pattern: Treating the partial 2026 as a full year, inflating or deflating growth, instead of computing growth to the last FULL year (2025) and marking 2026 as partial on charts.

prompt: Make a line chart of all 15 topics' trajectories over the years.
anti_pattern: Drawing 15 lines on one axis (unreadable) instead of a row-normalized heatmap or small multiples / a selected top-growers-vs-decliners set.

prompt: Give me an overall publications-per-year line by adding up every topic's yearly counts.
anti_pattern: Summing per-topic counts when topics overlap (double-counting) instead of using an umbrella query or the deduped corpus for the overall line.

prompt: Pick nice colors for the topic bars and the heatmap.
anti_pattern: Inventing an ad-hoc/rainbow palette instead of reading /dataviz and using its validated colorblind-safe sequential/diverging palette.
